CA-101.name: Brief validation
CA-101.action: Review the indicated input; do not invent missing facts.

CA-102.name: Product identity
CA-102.message: We couldn’t match the selected product or variant.
CA-102.action: Verify the saved product and variant.

CA-201.name: Service unavailable
CA-201.action: Retrieve an accepted request before any resubmission.

CA-202.name: Request timeout
CA-202.message: The request did not finish in time.
CA-202.action: Inspect saved response IDs and checkpoints; timeout does not prove no charge.

CA-203.name: Editable text preparation
CA-203.message: We couldn’t prepare the editable text.
CA-203.action: Inspect saved copy, region assignment and font metrics; preserve source artwork.

CA-204.name: Output validation
CA-204.message: The output did not pass a required check.
CA-204.action: Inspect the affected criterion; never mark approved automatically.

CA-301.name: Save failure
CA-301.action: Preserve browser draft; check disk and revision before retry.

CA-302.name: Download preparation
CA-302.action: Check saved revision, export and artifact availability.

CA-403.name: Access denied
CA-403.message: You don’t have access to this action.
CA-403.action: Check workspace access; do not bypass brand boundaries.

CA-404.name: Not found
CA-404.message: This project or asset couldn’t be found.
CA-404.action: Check resource identity and brand; never expose another workspace.

CA-409.name: Revision or request conflict
CA-409.message: This action conflicts with a saved change or request.
CA-409.action: Reload latest revision or inspect existing request; do not overwrite.

CA-429.name: Rate limit
CA-429.message: The service is receiving too many requests.
CA-429.action: Respect Retry-After and existing bounded retry policy.

CA-507.name: Storage full
CA-507.message: There is not enough storage to finish this action.
CA-507.action: Free space without deleting historical evidence.

CA-900.name: Unexpected failure
CA-900.action: Inspect incident record; classify only with evidence.
